audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Fizz all seven rows while the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna, Skill x5, Orianna. Every row disagreed.
audit.why: Fizz cannot dodge anything at level 1 — Playful / Trickster is not learned — so the 815-range Q genuinely wins that stage. Levels 2-5 are a bait-and-dodge skill stage. Level 6 and first item are his: Chum the Waters sticks from 1300 range and the shark knocks up, which needs no skill check from him. Two items returns the fight to Shockwave, which he cannot E out of once committed.
audit.corrected: Chart settled as Orianna, Skill, Skill, Skill, Fizz, Fizz, Orianna.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phases whys described Orianna spikes on stages the chart assigned to Fizz.
audit.why: Level 6 is his real spike, not Orianna's; the Luden's line was generic filler that ignored his Rocketbelt-timing burst.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to Chum the Waters and the first-item E-in burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number, and the Seastone Trident auto-reset tell was absent from the page.
audit.why: Playful / Trickster (E) is 16/14/12/10/8 and is untargetable through the hop, so the sequencing is bait-then-spend, and that 16s at rank 1 is the only window your Q-W actually sticks. Seastone Trident (W) is 7/6/5/4/3 and resets his auto — the wind-up is the cue. Urchin Strike is only 550 range. Chum the Waters is 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rebuilt on those numbers with the reset tell added; dos/donts keyed to the pole being up or down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds, one unsupported magnitude, 'Command Attack' for Command: Attack in two places.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Command: Protect for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
